analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Broadly
analysis.quote: Dropbox shares infrastructure, systems, and technology with other Dropbox Companies to provide, improve, protect, and promote Dropbox Company Services.

analysis.headline: Third Parties Access Your Info
analysis.quote: By doing so, you’re enabling Dropbox and those third parties to exchange information about you and data in your account so that Dropbox and those third parties can provide, improve, protect, and promote their services.

analysis.headline: Employer Controls Your Account
analysis.quote: If you are a user of a Dropbox Team, your administrator may have the ability to access and control your Dropbox Team account.

analysis.headline: Shares Your Data with Government
analysis.quote: We may disclose your information to third parties if we determine that such disclosure is reasonably necessary to: (a) comply with any applicable law, regulation, legal process, or appropriate government request

analysis.headline: Retains Your Data Indefinitely
analysis.quote: If you delete your account, we’ll initiate deletion of this information after 30 days. Learn more here . But please note: (1) there might be some latency in deleting this information from our servers and back-up storage; and (2) we may retain this information if necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, or enforce our agreements.

analysis.headline: Your Data Stored Globally
analysis.quote: To provide you with the Services, we may store, process, and transmit data in the United States and locations around the world—including those outside your country.

analysis.headline: Content Owners Track Your Views
analysis.quote: When you view content included in portions of our Services that provide analytics to content owners, we collect information including your identifying and device information, such as email addresses, IP addresses, and device identifiers of devices you use to view the content.

analysis.headline: Uses Your Data for AI/ML
analysis.quote: For more information on the lawful bases for processing your data, the categories of personal information included, and how we use artificial intelligence and machine learning, please see our FAQ .
